observations: A hand shadow holds a small rectangular object inside a hard-edged window-light field.
A second hand enters and interacts with the object shadow before leaving.
No readable rainbow dispersion, reflection path, refracted caustic, transmitted color, or transfer of a light property to a second carrier is visible.
decision: Do not treat the page title or glass prop as proof of a luminous relay. A visible optical property and carrier-to-carrier handoff are required.
